# Components inventory

This table is every engine build and model the Stack pins today, per role and per machine profile, drawn from the code by `bun run gen:components-doc` so it cannot drift from what the daemon actually installs. The tier is the machine profile (`p16` to `p128`, by unified memory on Apple silicon and by VRAM elsewhere), and for each role the Stack picks the largest pinned model that fits the machine's tier. The Catalog's signed index replaces this generator's source at STACK-97; until then a role with no pin lists its candidates from `dev.md` and the backlog, or says not yet.
